data.long_meaning: Mathesh is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Matri' meaning 'Mother' and 'Ishwar' meaning 'God'. The name Mathesh is believed to be a form of Lord Ganesha, the Hindu deity who is known as the God of Wisdom and the remover of obstacles. The name Mathesh carries the meaning “God of Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mathesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
